name: Flying Chairs
description: Synthetic optical-flow dataset comprising 22,872 image pairs with ground-truth flow fields, depicting rendered 3D chairs moving against random Flickr backgrounds.
citation: Dosovitskiy, A., Fischer, P., Ilg, E., Häusser, P., Hazırbaş, C., Golkov, V., van der Smagt, P., Cremers, D., & Brox, T. (2015). FlowNet: Learning Optical Flow with Convolutional Networks. IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV). https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1504.06852
